versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Paywall Upgrade Designer skill.
- Guides users through a structured, step-by-step framework to redesign SaaS paywall and upgrade screens for maximum free-to-paid conversion.
- Covers copy assessment, trigger placement strategy, outcome-based value framing, plan naming/structure, and pricing psychology using the Upgrade Moment Method.
- Generates a full, conversion-optimized upgrade screen specification tailored to user input.
- Designed for anyone seeking to improve paywall copy, CTA effectiveness, plan structure, and overall upgrade flow.
